author: Chris Schommer
title: Diamondbacks/Cardinals postponed Thursday
desc: Thursday's contest between the Arizona Diamondbacks and St. Louis Cardinals has been postponed due to inclement weather the club announced.
impact: The originally scheduled contest between the two clubs will be made up Thursday July 23.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Trent Grisham (hamstring) to require rehab assignment
desc: Yankees manager Aaron Boone said Trent Grisham will require a rehab assignment.
impact: Grisham took batting practice on Thursday. He'll likely be sent on a rehab assignment next week.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Juan Soto (back) returns to lineup Thursday
desc: Juan Soto is back in the Mets lineup on Thursday against the Cubs.
impact: Soto is batting third and serving as the designated hitter in his return.

author: Chase Davis
title: Kameron Misner whiffs three times, swipes bag in loss
desc: Kameron Misner went 0-for-4 in Wednesday's 5-3 loss to the Rays with one stolen base and three strikeouts.
impact: After Wednesday's loss to the Rays, Misner is batting .286 with zero home runs, four RBI and two stolen bases through 10 games. He's started just eight of 15 games since being activated from the IL, but has a 40% strikeout rate.

author: Chase Davis
title: Josh Rojas pops pinch-hit homer in Kansas City loss
desc: Josh Rojas went 1-for-1 in a loss to the Rays with a home run, one run scored and one RBI.
impact: Rojas was recalled from Triple-A on Tuesday and picked up a pinch-hit RBI double before smacking a pinch-hit homer on Wednesday. He has yet to start a game since being recalled.

author: Chase Davis
title: Noah Cameron labors through five in loss
desc: Noah Cameron allowed five earned runs on eight hits and two walks while striking out five over five innings in Wednesday's loss to the Rays.
impact: After this outing, Cameron owns a 4.50 ERA and 1.33 WHIP with a 4-5 record across 15 starts. He allowed five hard-hit balls and generated nine whiffs on 108 pitches. He's stumbled a little over his last three starts, but will look to right the ship next time out, again, against the Rays.

author: Chase Davis
title: Max Muncy chips in two hits, swipes a bag in tight win
desc: Max Muncy went 2-for-4 in a 4-3 win over the Twins with one RBI, one stolen base and two strikeouts.
impact: After the win, he's now batting .266 with 16 home runs, 34 RBI, 47 runs scored and a .379 wOBA through 75 games. He's in a little bit of a power dry spell but does have six RBI in his last six games. The stolen base was his first, although he's never had more than four in a season (twice).

author: Nate Miller
title: Evan Carter (oblique) to begin rehab assignment
desc: Evan Carter (oblique) will start a rehab assignment on Friday.
impact: Carter took live batting practice on Thursday, and he will head out on a rehab assignment over the weekend. The 23-year-old outfielder has been on the shelf since June 12, but he should return to the Rangers' lineup relatively soon. Carter is batting just .176 over 66 games on the year, but he has contributed six homers and 10 steals.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Zach Brzykcy optioned to Triple-A Jacksonville
desc: Zach Brzykcy was optioned to Triple-A Jacksonville by the Miami Marlins on Thursday.
impact: Brzykcy was on the big league club for just a few days and did not get an appearance before being sent back down to Triple-A. In 30 1/3 innings at that level this season, the right-hander has a 4.45 ERA and 34 strikeouts.

author: Chase Davis
title: Andy Pages goes hitless but swipes a bag in tight win
desc: Andy Pages went 0-for-4 in a win over the Twins with a walk, one stolen base and two strikeouts.
impact: After Wednesday's win over Minnesota, Pages is batting .266 with 15 home runs, 58 RBI and eight stolen bases across 80 games. He's in a bit of a slump, but still ranks second in the league in RBI.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Connor Norby optioned to Triple-A Jacksonville
desc: Connor Norby was optioned to Triple-A Jacksonville by the Marlins on Thursday.
impact: Norby has struggled to find a rhythm at the plate through his first 200 at-bats this season, slashing .205/.313/.325 with 70 strikeouts. The 26-year-old will look to recalibrate at the Triple-A level before potentially rejoining the Marlins later in the season.

author: Chase Davis
title: Mookie Betts stays hot with three-hit night, homer in 4-3 win
desc: Mookie Betts went 3-for-4 in a win over the Twins with a home run, a double, one run scored and one RBI.
impact: Through 46 games, Betts is slashing .230/.290/.415 with nine home runs, 21 RBI, 28 runs scored and a stolen base. Since his first June home run on June 14, he's batting .350 with three homers, seven runs scored, and four RBI over 10 games.

author: Nate Miller
title: Ryne Nelson (elbow,) moved to 60-day IL
desc: Ryne Nelson (elbow) was transferred to the 60-day IL on Thursday.
impact: This will open up a roster spot for the return of veteran outfielder Max Kepler from the restricted list. Nelson is dealing with a strained right elbow as well as a forearm injury. The righty is going to be out for an extended period, and he could end up missing the rest of the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Shane McClanahan to have next start pushed back
desc: The Rays are pushing back the next start for Shane McClanahan.
impact: McClanahan was scheduled to start on Saturday against the Diamondbacks. He'll likely be pushed back to a day early next week.

author: Chase Davis
title: Tanner Scott slams door as Dodgers edge Twins
desc: Tanner Scott struck out two batters while allowing one hit in a scoreless outing to earn the save in Wednesday's 4-3 win over the Twins.
impact: After Wednesday's win over the Twins, Scott now has a 2.18 ERA and 0.70 WHIP with 11 saves, and five holds across 35 appearances. He's had five consecutive scoreless outings since June 11 with a save.
